title: project-LICHEN-n8c6 review: wrong comment about push() seqnum consumption in link_layer.py
description: In link_layer.py _send_locked, lines 386-389: the comment states 'If push() raises QueueFullError the seqnum IS consumed (gap) because the frame was already built with that seqnum; reuse would cause replay confusion.' But push() is called BEFORE _next_seqnum(). If push() raises QueueFullError, _next_seqnum() is never reached, so seqnum is NOT consumed. The comment incorrectly describes the behavior. Also, the reasoning about replay confusion is questionable since the frame was never enqueued/transmitted.
